title: 隧道湧水排導系統
summary: 本課以用流量收支、重力排水與泵站備援管理隧道湧水為主線，從地下水與施工用水收支與支管流速與有效斷面建立系統邊界，再把集水容量與反應時間、堵塞敏感度與維護連到長期水文與維護交接。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on manage tunnel inflow through flow balance, gravity drainage and pump redundancy. It begins with Groundwater and process-water balance and Branch velocity and effective area, links Sump storage and response time and Blockage sensitivity and maintenance, and ends with Long-term hydrology and handover. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地下水與施工用水收支」與「支管流速與有效斷面」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Groundwater and process-water balance" and "Branch velocity and effective area": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地下水與施工用水收支：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Groundwater and process-water balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地下水與施工用水收支」如何影響隧道湧水排導系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Groundwater and process-water balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel inflow collection and drainage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水總量同時包含地層湧水、施工用水和儲存變化，不能全部算成天然地下水。泵站啟停造成出水脈動，應在相同時間窗比較流入與流出；若水槽水位改變，還須加入庫容項才可辨認真正湧水趨勢。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化；若出現施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地下水與施工用水收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Discharge combines groundwater, process water and storage change rather than natural inflow alone. Pump cycling makes outlet flow intermittent, requiring equal accounting windows. Include changing sump volume to identify the underlying groundwater trend instead of confusing operational pulses with geology. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. If higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Groundwater and process-water balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵站量到的全部出水都是地層自然湧水」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All water measured at the pump outlet is natural groundwater inflow" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地下水與施工用水收支」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Groundwater and process-water balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Discharge combines groundwater, process water and storage change rather than natural inflow alone. Pump cycling makes outlet flow intermittent, requiring equal accounting windows.

knowledge.text: 誤解：泵站量到的全部出水都是地層自然湧水 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「地下水與施工用水收支」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Groundwater and process-water balance" is correct?
options: 泵站量到的全部出水都是地層自然湧水

optionsEn: All water measured at the pump outlet is natural groundwater inflow

steps.title: 地下水與施工用水收支：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Groundwater and process-water balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地下水與施工用水收支」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Groundwater and process-water balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地下水與施工用水收支」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Groundwater and process-water balance", which statement holds?
options: 泵浦銘牌流量就是任何現地管路都能得到的流量
多裝一台備用泵就能排除所有排水失效

Adding one standby pump eliminates every drainage failure

steps.title: 地下水與施工用水收支：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Groundwater and process-water balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地下水與施工用水收支」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Groundwater and process-water balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地下水與施工用水收支」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Groundwater and process-water balance"?
options: 同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
排水量沒有增加就能保證地層沒有流失
optionsEn: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Unchanged discharge guarantees that no ground material is being lost
quiz.explanation: 同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地下水與施工用水收支：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Groundwater and process-water balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地下水與施工用水收支」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Groundwater and process-water balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化；若出現施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵站量到的全部出水都是地層自然湧水」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All water measured at the pump outlet is natural groundwater inflow" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地下水與施工用水收支」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Groundwater and process-water balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置。
名義管徑足夠就不需要檢查有效過水斷面
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response.
Adequate nominal diameter removes the need to check effective flow area
quiz.explanation: 施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 支管流速與有效斷面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Branch velocity and effective area: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支管流速與有效斷面」如何影響隧道湧水排導系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Branch velocity and effective area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel inflow collection and drainage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 支管輸水能力受實際有效斷面影響，沉積、變形和局部堵塞都會改變速度與水位。用公稱管徑計算可能漏掉積泥，量測高流速也不一定表示容量充足，因為上游可能已積水；應同時看流量、斷面與水頭。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面；若出現積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支管流速與有效斷面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Branch performance depends on effective area altered by sediment, deformation and blockage. Nominal diameter can miss deposits, and high velocity does not prove spare capacity if water is already backing up. Interpret flow, section geometry and head together rather than velocity alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure velocity, deposit depth and upstream level to reconstruct effective area. If sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Branch velocity and effective area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「名義管徑足夠就不需要檢查有效過水斷面」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate nominal diameter removes the need to check effective flow area" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支管流速與有效斷面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Branch velocity and effective area”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支管流速與有效斷面
knowledge.text: 支管輸水能力受實際有效斷面影響，沉積、變形和局部堵塞都會改變速度與水位。用公稱管徑計算可能漏掉積泥，量測高流速也不一定表示容量充足，因為上游可能已積水；應同時看流量、斷面與水頭。
knowledge.textEn: Branch performance depends on effective area altered by sediment, deformation and blockage. Nominal diameter can miss deposits, and high velocity does not prove spare capacity if water is already backing up.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：名義管徑足夠就不需要檢查有效過水斷面 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate nominal diameter removes the need to check effective flow area Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支管流速與有效斷面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Branch velocity and effective area" is correct?
options: 名義管徑足夠就不需要檢查有效過水斷面
排水管兩端高程正確就代表中間一定順坡
支管輸水能力受實際有效斷面影響，沉積、變形和局部堵塞都會改變速度與水位。
optionsEn: Adequate nominal diameter removes the need to check effective flow area
Correct end elevations guarantee a continuously descending drain
Branch performance depends on effective area altered by sediment, deformation and blockage.
quiz.explanation: 支管輸水能力受實際有效斷面影響，沉積、變形和局部堵塞都會改變速度與水位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Branch performance depends on effective area altered by sediment, deformation and blockage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支管流速與有效斷面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Branch velocity and effective area: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支管流速與有效斷面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Branch velocity and effective area” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure velocity, deposit depth and upstream level to reconstruct effective area.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支管流速與有效斷面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Branch velocity and effective area", which statement holds?
options: 集水槽總容積全部都能當作停泵備援容量
管徑減少百分之二十就只會少百分之二十排水能力
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s.
The entire gross sump volume is available as pump-failure storage
A twenty-percent diameter loss reduces drainage capacity by only twenty percent
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支管流速與有效斷面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Branch velocity and effective area: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支管流速與有效斷面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Branch velocity and effective area” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure velocity, deposit depth and upstream level to reconstruct effective area. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Measure velocity, deposit depth and upstream level to reconstruct effective area. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Measure velocity, deposit depth and upstream level to reconstruct effective area. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Measure velocity, deposit depth and upstream level to reconstruct effective area. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支管流速與有效斷面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Branch velocity and effective area"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面。
出水濃度下降就一定代表排出污染總量下降
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Measure velocity, deposit depth and upstream level to reconstruct effective area.
Lower effluent concentration necessarily means a lower total contaminant discharge
quiz.explanation: 量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure velocity, deposit depth and upstream level to reconstruct effective area. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支管流速與有效斷面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Branch velocity and effective area: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支管流速與有效斷面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Branch velocity and effective area” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure velocity, deposit depth and upstream level to reconstruct effective area to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面；若出現積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「名義管徑足夠就不需要檢查有效過水斷面」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate nominal diameter removes the need to check effective flow area" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure velocity, deposit depth and upstream level to reconstruct effective area to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支管流速與有效斷面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Branch velocity and effective area" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
排水管兩端高程正確就代表中間一定順坡
積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Correct end elevations guarantee a continuously descending drain
Sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate.
quiz.explanation: 積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
